title: Wrapping Dumplings
synopsis: Learn how to make this iconic Chinese dish!

fullText.simplified:
包饺子

    俗话说：“不到长城非好汉，不吃中国饺子真遗憾！”饺子是每个中国人都喜欢吃的美食，很多在中国的外国朋友也特别喜欢吃。今天就教大家包饺子。
    中国有各种各样的饺子馅儿：猪肉的、牛肉的、羊肉的、蔬菜的等等。今天教大家牛肉胡萝卜馅儿的饺子。
    需要准备的材料是：牛肉、胡萝卜、油、盐、酱油、香油、葱、姜和面粉。
    首先要做的是和面。在盆里放上面粉，然后加入适量的水，就可以开始和面了。怎么确定面和好了呢？只要面粉变成白白胖胖的一团，而且不沾手就可以了。和好面以后，把面团用盖子盖好，放在一边。
    接下来就是做饺子馅儿了。把牛肉和胡萝卜洗干净，然后把牛肉切碎，越碎越好。再把胡萝卜切成细细的胡萝卜丝。然后把葱和姜切得碎碎的。这些都做完以后，开火，把锅放在火上边。锅热了以后，放入适量的油。油热后，把葱和姜放进去，闻到香味以后，关火。把肉和胡萝卜放进去，再放入适当的盐、酱油以及香油，用筷子搅拌均匀。这样饺子馅儿就准备好了。
    所有的材料都准备好了以后，就可以包饺子了。包饺子还有一个最重要的部分就是擀饺子皮。先拿出一小块面，然后用手搓成长条，再把长条切成一个一个的小块，和草莓的大小差不多就行。然后用擀面杖或者圆柱形的东西把这各个小块面擀成圆片就可以了。需要注意的是，圆片要不薄不厚正合适。饺子皮做好后，就可以把饺子馅儿放进饺子皮中间。饺子馅儿不要太多，饺子皮上下两边可以放在一起就可以了。最后用手使劲捏紧上下两个边，这样一个饺子就包好了。
    饺子包好后，锅里放入水。水开以后，把饺子放进去，煮大概十分钟，所有的饺子都飘在水面上，饺子就熟了。
    如果你对中国美食感兴趣，可以试着包一下饺子哦！
fullText.traditional:
包餃子

    俗話說：“不到長城非好漢，不吃中國餃子真遺憾！”餃子是每個中國人都喜歡吃的美食，很多在中國的外國朋友也特別喜歡吃。今天就教大家包餃子。
    中國有各種各樣的餃子餡兒：豬肉的、牛肉的、羊肉的、蔬菜的等等。今天教大家牛肉胡蘿蔔餡兒的餃子。
    需要準備的材料是：牛肉、胡蘿蔔、油、鹽、醬油、香油、蔥、薑和麵粉。
    首先要做的是和麵。在盆裡放上麵粉，然後加入適量的水，就可以開始和麵了。怎麼確定麵和好了呢？只要麵粉變成白白胖胖的一團，而且不沾手就可以了。和好麵以後，把麵團用蓋子蓋好，放在一邊。
    接下來就是做餃子餡兒了。把牛肉和胡蘿蔔洗乾淨，然後把牛肉切碎，越碎越好。再把胡蘿蔔切成細細的胡蘿蔔絲。然後把蔥和薑切得碎碎的。這些都做完以後，開火，把鍋放在火上邊。鍋熱了以後，放入適量的油。油熱後，把蔥和薑放進去，聞到香味以後，關火。把肉和胡蘿蔔放進去，再放入適當的鹽、醬油以及香油，用筷子攪拌均勻。這樣餃子餡兒就準備好了。
    所有的材料都準備好了以後，就可以包餃子了。包餃子還有一個最重要的部分就是擀餃子皮。先拿出一小塊麵，然後用手搓成長條，再把長條切成一個一個的小塊，和草莓的大小差不多就行。然後用擀麵杖或者圓柱形的東西把這各個小塊麵擀成圓片就可以了。需要注意的是，圓片要不薄不厚正合適。餃子皮做好後，就可以把餃子餡兒放進餃子皮中間。餃子餡兒不要太多，餃子皮上下兩邊可以放在一起就可以了。最後用手使勁捏緊上下兩個邊，這樣一個餃子就包好了。
    餃子包好後，鍋裡放入水。水開以後，把餃子放進去，煮大概十分鐘，所有的餃子都飄在水面上，餃子就熟了。
    如果你對中國美食感興趣，可以試著包一下餃子哦！

sentences.english: Dumplings are a delicacy that every Chinese person likes to eat. Many foreigners in China also particularly like to eat them.
Today I'm going to teach everyone how to wrap dumplings.

sentences.simplified: 今天教大家牛肉胡萝卜馅儿的饺子。
sentences.traditional: 今天教大家牛肉胡蘿蔔餡兒的餃子。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān jiāo dà jiā niú ròu hú luó bo xiàn'r de jiǎo zi
sentences.english: China has all sorts of dumpling fillings: pork, beef, lamb, vegetarian, and so on.
Today I'm going to teach everyone dumplings filled with beef and carrots.

sentences.simplified: 需要准备的材料是：牛肉、胡萝卜、油、盐、酱油、香油、葱、姜和面粉。
sentences.traditional: 需要準備的材料是：牛肉、胡蘿蔔、油、鹽、醬油、香油、蔥、薑和麵粉。
sentences.pinyin: xū yào zhǔn bèi de cái liào shì niú ròu hú luó bo yóu yán jiàng yóu xiāng yóu cōng jiāng hé miàn fěn

sentences.english: The ingredients you need to prepare are beef, carrots, oil, salt, soy sauce, sesame oil, green onions, ginger, and flour.

sentences.simplified: 首先要做的是和面。
sentences.traditional: 首先要做的是和麵。
sentences.pinyin: shǒu xiān yào zuò de shì huó miàn

sentences.simplified: 在盆里放上面粉，然后加入适量的水，就可以开始和面了。
sentences.traditional: 在盆裡放上麵粉，然後加入適量的水，就可以開始和麵了。
sentences.pinyin: zài pén lǐ fàng shàng miàn fěn rán hòu jiā rù shì liàng de shuǐ jiù kě yǐ kāi shǐ huó miàn le
sentences.english: The first thing we must do is knead the dough.

sentences.simplified: 怎么确定面和好了呢？
sentences.traditional: 怎麼確定麵和好了呢？
sentences.pinyin: zěn me què dìng miàn huó hǎo le ne
sentences.english: Place flour inside a bowl, then add an appropriate amount of water. Now we can start to knead the dough.

sentences.simplified: 只要面粉变成白白胖胖的一团，而且不沾手就可以了。
sentences.traditional: 只要麵粉變成白白胖胖的一團，而且不沾手就可以了。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yào miàn fěn biàn chéng bái bái pàng pàng de yì tuán ér qiě bù zhān shǒu jiù kě yǐ le
sentences.english: How can we determine if the dough is well kneaded?

sentences.simplified: 和好面以后，把面团用盖子盖好，放在一边。
sentences.traditional: 和好麵以後，把麵團用蓋子蓋好，放在一邊。
sentences.pinyin: huó hǎo miàn yǐ hòu bǎ miàn tuán yòng gài zi gài hǎo fàng zài yì biān
sentences.english: If the flour has become a white, fat ball, and doesn't stick to your hands, then it is ready.
After you're finished kneading, cover the dough with a lid and put it aside.

sentences.simplified: 接下来就是做饺子馅儿了。把牛肉和胡萝卜洗干净，然后把牛肉切碎，越碎越好。
sentences.traditional: 接下來就是做餃子餡兒了。把牛肉和胡蘿蔔洗乾淨，然後把牛肉切碎，越碎越好。
sentences.pinyin: jiē xià lái jiù shì zuò jiǎo zi xiàn'r le bǎ niú ròu hé hú luó bo xǐ gān jìng rán hòu bǎ niú ròu qiē suì yuè suì yuè hǎo

sentences.simplified: 再把胡萝卜切成细细的胡萝卜丝。然后把葱和姜切得碎碎的。
sentences.traditional: 再把胡蘿蔔切成細細的胡蘿蔔絲。然後把蔥和薑切得碎碎的。
sentences.pinyin: zài bǎ hú luó bo qiē chéng xì xì de hú luó bo sī rán hòu bǎ cōng hé jiāng qiē de suì suì de
sentences.english: Next, we will make the dumpling filling. Wash the beef and carrots, then dice the beef, the finer the better.

sentences.simplified: 这些都做完以后，开火，把锅放在火上边。
sentences.traditional: 這些都做完以後，開火，把鍋放在火上邊。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē dōu zuò wán yǐ hòu kāi huǒ bǎ guō fàng zài huǒ shàng bian
sentences.english: Then cut the carrots into thin strands. Afterward, dice the green onions and ginger.

sentences.simplified: 锅热了以后，放入适量的油。
sentences.traditional: 鍋熱了以後，放入適量的油。
sentences.pinyin: guō rè le yǐ hòu fàng rù shì liàng de yóu
sentences.english: Once this is all done, turn on the stove and place the wok on the heat.

sentences.simplified: 油热后，把葱和姜放进去，闻到香味以后，关火。
sentences.traditional: 油熱後，把蔥和薑放進去，聞到香味以後，關火。
sentences.pinyin: yóu rè hòu bǎ cōng hé jiāng fàng jìn qù wén dào xiāng wèi yǐ hòu guān huǒ
sentences.english: After the wok gets hot, put in an appropriate amount of oil.

sentences.simplified: 把肉和胡萝卜放进去，再放入适当的盐、酱油以及香油，用筷子搅拌均匀。
sentences.traditional: 把肉和胡蘿蔔放進去，再放入適當的鹽、醬油以及香油，用筷子攪拌均勻。
sentences.pinyin: bǎ ròu hé hú luó bo fàng jìn qù zài fàng rù shì dàng de yán jiàng yóu yǐ jí xiāng yóu yòng kuài zi jiǎo bàn jūn yún
sentences.english: Once the oil is hot, add the green onions and ginger. Once you are able to smell the aroma, turn off the heat.

sentences.simplified: 这样饺子馅儿就准备好了。
sentences.traditional: 這樣餃子餡兒就準備好了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng jiǎo zi xiàn'r jiù zhǔn bèi hǎo le
sentences.english: Add the meat and carrots, then add an appropriate amount of salt, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Use chopsticks to stir evenly.
The dumpling filling is now ready.

sentences.simplified: 所有的材料都准备好了以后，就可以包饺子了。
sentences.traditional: 所有的材料都準備好了以後，就可以包餃子了。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǒu de cái liào dōu zhǔn bèi hǎo le yǐ hòu jiù kě yǐ bāo jiǎo zi le

sentences.simplified: 包饺子还有一个最重要的部分就是擀饺子皮。
sentences.traditional: 包餃子還有一個最重要的部分就是擀餃子皮。
sentences.pinyin: bāo jiǎo zi hái yǒu yí ge zuì zhòng yào de bù fen jiù shì gǎn jiǎo zi pí
sentences.english: After all the ingredients have been prepared, we can start wrapping the dumplings.

sentences.simplified: 先拿出一小块面，然后用手搓成长条，
sentences.traditional: 先拿出一小塊麵，然後用手搓成長條，
sentences.pinyin: xiān ná chū yì xiǎo kuài miàn rán hòu yòng shǒu cuō chéng cháng tiáo
sentences.english: When wrapping dumplings, there most important part is rolling out the dumpling skin.

sentences.simplified: 再把长条切成一个一个的小块，和草莓的大小差不多就行。
sentences.traditional: 再把長條切成一個一個的小塊，和草莓的大小差不多就行。
sentences.pinyin: zài bǎ cháng tiáo qiē chéng yí ge yí ge de xiǎo kuài hé cǎo méi de dà xiǎo chà bu duō jiù xíng
sentences.english: First, take out a small piece of dough, then use your hands to roll it into a long strand.

sentences.simplified: 然后用擀面杖或者圆柱形的东西把这各个小块面擀成圆片就可以了。
sentences.traditional: 然後用擀麵杖或者圓柱形的東西把這各個小塊麵擀成圓片就可以了。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu yòng gǎn miàn zhàng huò zhě yuán zhù xíng de dōng xi bǎ zhè gè gè xiǎo kuài miàn gǎn chéng yuán piàn jiù kě yǐ le
sentences.english: Next, cut the long strand into individual small pieces, about the size of a strawberry.

sentences.simplified: 需要注意的是，圆片要不薄不厚正合适。
sentences.traditional: 需要注意的是，圓片要不薄不厚正合適。
sentences.pinyin: xū yào zhù yì de shì yuán piàn yào bù báo bú hòu zhèng hé shì
sentences.english: Then use a rolling pin or cylindrical object to roll each small piece of dough into a round disc.

sentences.simplified: 饺子皮做好后，就可以把饺子馅儿放进饺子皮中间。
sentences.traditional: 餃子皮做好後，就可以把餃子餡兒放進餃子皮中間。
sentences.pinyin: jiǎo zi pí zuò hǎo hòu jiù kě yǐ bǎ jiǎo zi xiàn'r fàng jìn jiǎo zi pí zhōng jiān
sentences.english: It's important to make sure that the round discs are not too thin nor too thick, but just right.

sentences.simplified: 饺子馅儿不要太多，饺子皮上下两边可以放在一起就可以了。
sentences.traditional: 餃子餡兒不要太多，餃子皮上下兩邊可以放在一起就可以了。
sentences.pinyin: jiǎo zi xiàn'r bú yào tài duō jiǎo zi pí shàng xià liǎng biān kě yǐ fàng zài yì qǐ jiù kě yǐ le
sentences.english: After the dumpling skins are ready we can then place the dumpling filling inside the dumpling skins.

sentences.simplified: 最后用手使劲捏紧上下两个边，这样一个饺子就包好了。
sentences.traditional: 最後用手使勁捏緊上下兩個邊，這樣一個餃子就包好了。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu yòng shǒu shǐ jìn niē jǐn shàng xià liǎng ge biān zhè yàng yí ge jiǎo zi jiù bāo hǎo le
sentences.english: There should not be too much dumpling filling. The top and bottom edges of the dumpling skin should be joined together.
Finally, use your hands to firmly pinch the top and bottom edges tightly together. You have now successfully wrapped a dumpling.

sentences.simplified: 饺子包好后，锅里放入水。
sentences.traditional: 餃子包好後，鍋裡放入水。
sentences.pinyin: jiǎo zi bāo hǎo hòu guō lǐ fàng rù shuǐ

sentences.simplified: 水开以后，把饺子放进去，煮大概十分钟，
sentences.traditional: 水開以後，把餃子放進去，煮大概十分鐘，
sentences.pinyin: shuǐ kāi yǐ hòu bǎ jiǎo zi fàng jìn qù zhǔ dà gài shí fēn zhōng
sentences.english: After you're done wrapping dumplings, pour water into a wok.

sentences.simplified: 所有的饺子都飘在水面上，饺子就熟了。
sentences.traditional: 所有的餃子都飄在水面上，餃子就熟了。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǒu de jiǎo zi dōu piāo zài shuǐ miàn shang jiǎo zi jiù shú le
sentences.english: After the water has come to a boil, put in the dumplings and cook for about 10 minutes.
When all the dumplings float to the surface of the water, the dumplings are cooked.

sentences.simplified: 如果你对中国美食感兴趣，可以试着包一下饺子哦！
sentences.traditional: 如果你對中國美食感興趣，可以試著包一下餃子哦！
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ duì zhōng guó měi shí gǎn xìng qù kě yǐ shì zhe bāo yí xià jiǎo zi o

raw.synopsis: Learn how to make this iconic Chinese dish!
sentence_translations: Wrapping Dumplings
As the saying goes: "You are not a true man until you have climbed the Great Wall; if you don't eat Chinese dumplings, you will regret it!"
Dumplings are a delicacy that every Chinese person likes to eat. Many foreigners in China also particularly like to eat them.
Today I'm going to teach everyone how to wrap dumplings.
China has all sorts of dumpling fillings: pork, beef, lamb, vegetarian, and so on.
Today I'm going to teach everyone dumplings filled with beef and carrots.
The ingredients you need to prepare are beef, carrots, oil, salt, soy sauce, sesame oil, green onions, ginger, and flour.
The first thing we must do is knead the dough.
Place flour inside a bowl, then add an appropriate amount of water. Now we can start to knead the dough.
How can we determine if the dough is well kneaded?
If the flour has become a white, fat ball, and doesn't stick to your hands, then it is ready.
After you're finished kneading, cover the dough with a lid and put it aside.
Next, we will make the dumpling filling. Wash the beef and carrots, then dice the beef, the finer the better.
Then cut the carrots into thin strands. Afterward, dice the green onions and ginger.
Once this is all done, turn on the stove and place the wok on the heat.
After the wok gets hot, put in an appropriate amount of oil.
Once the oil is hot, add the green onions and ginger. Once you are able to smell the aroma, turn off the heat.
Add the meat and carrots, then add an appropriate amount of salt, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Use chopsticks to stir evenly.
The dumpling filling is now ready.
After all the ingredients have been prepared, we can start wrapping the dumplings.
When wrapping dumplings, there most important part is rolling out the dumpling skin.
First, take out a small piece of dough, then use your hands to roll it into a long strand.
Next, cut the long strand into individual small pieces, about the size of a strawberry.
Then use a rolling pin or cylindrical object to roll each small piece of dough into a round disc.
It's important to make sure that the round discs are not too thin nor too thick, but just right.
After the dumpling skins are ready we can then place the dumpling filling inside the dumpling skins.
There should not be too much dumpling filling. The top and bottom edges of the dumpling skin should be joined together.
Finally, use your hands to firmly pinch the top and bottom edges tightly together. You have now successfully wrapped a dumpling.
After you're done wrapping dumplings, pour water into a wok.
After the water has come to a boil, put in the dumplings and cook for about 10 minutes.
When all the dumplings float to the surface of the water, the dumplings are cooked.
If you are interested in Chinese food, you can have a go wrapping dumplings!
